Key Capabilities & Architecture

Muscle Readiness Engine

Algorithmic recovery score (0–100%) per muscle group using time-decay workload modeling.

Adaptive Split Generator

Auto-generated PPL, Upper/Lower, and Full Body routines tailored to your days and equipment.

Focused Live Set Tracker

Fast weight/rep logging with built-in haptic rest timers that stay reliable in the background.

PR & Tonnage Analytics

Personal records tracking, muscle balance breakdown, and long-term volume progression.

Tech stack: React NativeExpo RouterZustandSupabaseRevenueCat

FAQ

Does SPOT work offline inside a gym basement? +
Yes. All active workout logging, rest timers, and history work 100% offline and sync smoothly once reconnected.
How does Muscle Readiness calculate recovery? +
It uses a time-decay fatigue model based on logged sets, intensity, and muscle group recovery windows.
